messages.content:
Complete the requested file edits. Available tools: read, edit, write. Paths are relative to the working directory. Preserve all bytes outside the requested changes. When done, reply with a short confirmation and no tool call.

Files in the working directory:
- sample.txt
- untouched.txt

Perform only the following mechanical file edits. The required change is fully specified; no bug investigation is needed.

All file paths are relative to the current working directory. Open explicitly named files directly; search for their location only if the supplied path cannot be resolved. Searching within files for the requested content is allowed.
There is no Git repository in this workspace. Do not run Git commands or create a Git repository.

Quoted text in this request uses JSON string notation: decode escapes to the actual characters. Treat it as literal text, not a regular expression.

In sample.txt replace the exact text "old\r\nline" with "new\r\nline".

Leave all text outside the requested edits unchanged. Do not create extra files. Choose any available tools, including Bash. Complete the edits and then finish.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. `offset` is a one-based source line and `limit` is a number of source lines. Output is bounded by line, byte, and line-length limits. When the result reports truncation, follow the continuation it returns instead of guessing the next `offset`. Paths outside the allowed roots, binary content, and special files are refused.

path.description: Path to read, relative to the working directory or absolute within an allowed root.

offset.description: One-based source line to start reading at. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of source lines to return, before the configured limits apply.

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a text file by replacing text. `old_string` must match exactly one place in the file: add surrounding lines to make it unique, or set `replace_all` to change every place. `old_string` must match the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation. Copy old text from the file without the line-number prefix the read tool adds. Read the file with the read tool before you edit it. After an edit, the same file can be edited again without another read. To create a file or replace all of its content, use the write tool.

path.description: Path of the file to edit, relative to the working directory or absolute within an allowed root.

old_string.description: Text to replace. It must match one place in the file unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Send an empty string to delete old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every place old_string matches. Default false.

function.name: write
function.description: Create a text file, or replace all of its content. Missing parent directories are created. To replace a file that exists, read all of it with the read tool first. To change part of a file, use the edit tool: it sends less text and keeps the rest of the file as it is.

path.description: Path of the file to create or replace, relative to the working directory or absolute within an allowed root.

content.description: The complete new content of the file. Nothing of the old content is kept.
